notes: Study/coordination bill; sole evidence is the Introduced-in-House text (140 lines, 5558 chars); no referencedSources registered. All figures (180 days, 2 years, EO 13577, 76 Fed. Reg. 35715, section 8(c)(2), 47 U.S.C. 1607(c)(2)), entities (SelectUSA, Executive Director, Dept of Commerce, Federal Interagency Investment Working Group, Senate Commerce = Committee on Commerce Science and Transportation, House Energy and Commerce), directions (shall/solicit/report/no funds), and coverage of all 6 sections verify against source. No material issues. Minor items: (1) gaps[1] 'industry groups have identified...' is an unsupported extrinsic aside; (2) top_lines[0].subs[0] pins the three vulnerable segments (from Sec 3(4) findings) to the Sec 4 solicitation, which the text scopes as 'any segment of semiconductor-related production' — supported but a mild attribution stretch; (3) Sec 3 item compresses 'Federal Government can leverage FDI' (3(5)) + SelectUSA 'positioned to boost FDI' (3(6)) into SelectUSA leveraging FDI; (4) likelihoodReason breadth-of-support framing ('bipartisan support', 'broad bipartisan appeal') is unsourced style debt per rubric class 8; cosponsor count 2 is live metadata (introduced text shows one cosponsor).
